scenes.text: Claude built an onboarding checklist with one hard rule. Every task is due a set number of days from the start date. If that lands on a weekend, it moves to the Friday before.
The test build found forty-four gaps. Check-in notes were private, yet any role could own a check-in. And the people team could deactivate themselves. All forty-four are fixed.
BambooHR starts at two hundred and fifty dollars a month, but that buys a whole HR system. If onboarding is the part you need, build your own.
